values.note: Kalamazoo County: camping $29 a night, one rate for everyone, including the entrance fee for one vehicle (extra vehicles $5 a day or a $30 annual pass). $5 non-refundable reservation fee per site; cancelling costs $5, and under two weeks out the first two nights.

fees.source: https://www.kalcounty.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Cold-Brook-Park-1 ('Camping per night $29', 'Reservation Fee $5', 'The camping fees include the entrance fee for one vehicle') + https://www.kalcounty.gov/1221/Camping FAQ (refund policy), read in the browser 2026-10-25 (plain HTTP gets 403)

hookups.source: https://www.kalcounty.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Cold-Brook-Park-1 ('29 Sites with Electric and Water'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 29 improved sites with electric and water; accessible sites 7 and 24. One camping unit per site (a small extra tent for juveniles or supplies allowed).

sites.source: https://www.kalcounty.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Cold-Brook-Park-1 ('29 Improved Campsites', 'Accessible campsites available (sites 7 and 24)') + https://www.kalcounty.gov/1221/Camping FAQ, read 2026-10-25

values.note: 2026 dates: 'Cold Brook Campground will open for the season on April 24, 2026'; 'Both campgrounds close for the season on November 1, 2026.'

Advance reservations required, no walk-ins: call the Parks Office 269-383-8778, Mon-Fri 8 am - 4:30 pm. Reservations for the current year only, from the first business day of January. After 14 nights campers must leave for two nights before returning.

booking.source: https://www.kalcounty.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Cold-Brook-Park-1 ('Advance reservations are required. No walk-in reservations will be accepted. To make a reservation, call the Parks Office at 269-383-8778') + https://www.kalcounty.gov/1221/Camping FAQ ('Minimum stay: Two nights for weekend reservations. Maximum stay: Fourteen nights. note: Kalamazoo County Parks campground in Climax, in a 276-acre park of three lakes and wetlands with a swim beach, boat ramp and disc golf; a separate rustic area also exists. Single drive-in loop off E MN Ave near I-94 (some road noise). --Claude
